title: Com'è? Descrivere le persone
summary: Describing people's looks and personality, plus the invariable idiom essere in gamba

blocks.title: Com'è? — l'aspetto fisico
blocks.body: To describe how someone looks: *alto/alta* (tall), *basso/bassa* (short), *giovane* (young — same for m/f), *anziano/anziana* (older, the polite word for people), *biondo/bionda* (blond).
blocks.callout: For people, anziano is the polite choice — vecchio can sound blunt.

blocks.title: Com'è? — il carattere, e in gamba
blocks.body: For personality: *simpatico/simpatica* (nice, likeable), *gentile* (kind — two-ending), *divertente* (funny), *timido/timida* (shy). One handy idiom never changes shape: **in gamba** — literally 'on the leg', it means capable, switched-on, sharp: *è in gamba*, *sono in gamba*, *siete in gamba* — same words every time.
blocks.callout: in gamba is invariable — no agreement, just drop it in after essere.

blocks.title: vecchio vs anziano — same idea, different tone

pairs.note: Un tavolo vecchio is fine; call a person anziano, not vecchio, to stay polite.

blocks.prompt: Which is correct: 'Giulia is very nice'?
blocks.explain: simpatico is a four-ending adjective; Giulia is feminine singular, so simpatica.
in gamba is an idiom for capable, switched-on, sharp — nothing to do with legs anymore.

blocks.prompt: Type 'he is very nice' in Italian.
blocks.hint: simpatico agrees with a masculine subject here.
blocks.explain: *È molto simpatico* — simpatico stays masculine since 'he' is male.

blocks.prompt: Listen and type the whole line.

blocks.scene: Giulia describes your mutual friends over coffee

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: Allora, conosci già Marco: è simpatico, ma un po' pigro.
lines.en: So, you already know Marco: he's nice, but a bit lazy.

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: Esatto. E Sofia? È timida all'inizio, ma è davvero in gamba.
lines.en: Exactly. And Sofia? She's shy at first, but she's really sharp.
lines.spotlight: in gamba doesn't change with gender — same phrase for anyone.

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.en: Really kind. She's a special person.

blocks.prompt: Describe two people you know — one physical trait and one personality trait each. Try using in gamba for someone impressive!
